title: Sparkline Quickstart: Guided Checkpoints & Empty-State Illustration Set
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a compact, scannable quickstart visual system for first-run Console users focused on guided checkpoints and empty-state scaffolds. Deliver an asset kit (Figma file + PNG/AVIF exports) that supports a 3-step first-run checklist, progressive tips, and a tiny sparkline-style progress indicator. This ticket covers art direction, accessibility contrasts, microcopy variants for developer and enterprise personas, and a small animated SVG prototype for the sparkline checkpoint flow.
assets: Drive doc: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/XXXXX - quickstart copy matrix + test prompts
mockups: variant-A_instant-onboard - three-step checklist with left rail helper (figma frame)
variant-B_compact-toast - inline tips for minimal chrome (figma frame)
empty-state-illustrations - set of 6 SVG illustrations sized for 280x200 and 560x400
sparkline-flow - sequence of 4 frames showing checkpoint progression and fallback state
screenshots_needed: First-run dashboard empty state (1280x800, dark + light)
Checklist modal opened with 1 of 3 completed (mobile, tablet, desktop)
Sparkline micro-animation captured as GIF and static fallback PNG
Settings prompt for Connect model / API key step (show masked API input)
Success state after onboarding complete with CTA to explore models
acceptance_criteria: Figma master file contains all artboards and slices for export
PNG/AVIF exports for each empty-state and checklist tile in the required resolutions
Animated SVG/Lottie for sparkline with 3fps and 30fps versions and a static fallback
Microcopy variants: developer, platform-engineer, and enterprise admin are present and reviewed
Accessibility: color contrast >= 4.5:1 for primary CTA and >= 3:1 for helper text
Design handoff notes and tokens published to the Console design system library
decisions: Use sparkline motif (thin horizontal progress line with subtle glow) instead of circular progress to keep header real-estate low
Illustration style to be low-detail, single-accent color plus neutral greys to match Console aesthetics
Microcopy will prioritize brevity and actionability: verbs first, then context (e.g., 'Connect a model — 2 min')
Animations limited to 500ms with prefers-reduced-motion fallback
No embedded onboarding video on first-run; keep assets lightweight for slow network regions
